title: viola serpens var. pilosa
intro: Viola serpens var. pilosa, commonly known as Wood Sorrel, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Violet family (Violaceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, which include the ability to act as a diuretic, helping to reduce water retention and alleviate symptoms of urinary tract infections. The therapeutic actions of Viola serpens var. pilosa include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues.
